purpose: Pinned descriptor for the finite Stage-A replay commands. This descriptor is part of the submitted replay archive and is digest-bound by certificates/stage_a_digest_table.json plus the outer printed ledger.

filesystem_contract.path_syntax: POSIX-style relative manifest strings with forward slashes
filesystem_contract.symlink_rejection: reject when Path.lstat() reports a symbolic link at the final directory entry
filesystem_contract.ordinary_file_requirement: Path.lstat() final entry must be a regular file
excluded_inputs: case-folding aliases that identify two distinct manifest strings
hard-link aliases outside the submitted root

json_contract.object_duplicate_key_policy: last parsed value retained by CPython json

host_provenance_observed_not_normative.normative_status: provenance only; replay acceptance depends on this descriptor and byte equality, not on an unrecorded local host
